meta.title: Settings Roam
meta.description: Push portable settings to the cloud, pull them back on a new machine.

title: Settings Roam
intro: This section only carries settings that can travel (models and endpoints). Machine addresses, theme, tool permissions, and the default model stay here.

config.title: Cloud repository
config.unavailable: The settings service is not ready, so these fields cannot be edited yet. Reload the page and try again.
config.failed: The change was not saved. This entry is most likely declared somewhere else too (for example the profile cordis.patch.yml or the command line), which would override the edit.

repoUrl.label: Repository URL
repoUrl.hint: Remote Git repository. Push and Pull become available once this is set.

branch.label: Branch for the backup
branch.hint: One repository can hold backups from several plugins, each on its own branch. Empty uses settings-roam.

profileName.label: Profile to sync
profileName.hint: Leave empty to detect automatically. Required when this machine has several profiles.

exportRoot.label: Export directory
exportRoot.hint: Export to file writes the backup here. Empty uses the default directory.

importRoot.label: Import directory
importRoot.hint: Import looks here for a previously exported package; empty uses the export directory above.

status.needsConfig: No cloud repository yet. Fill in the repository URL under “Cloud repository” below to enable pushing.
status.emptyCloud: The cloud is still empty. Export or push once from this machine first.
status.clean: Local settings loaded; use Compare with cloud to verify sync status.
status.diff: {n} changes on the cloud are waiting to be pulled.
status.review: Check the differences above; nothing is written until you confirm.
status.needsProfile: This machine has several profiles — pick the one to sync in the first block.

comparison.title: Cloud comparison
comparison.same: The cloud and this machine match.
comparison.localTimeHint: File-level modification time, not a per-field audit time.
comparison.remoteTimeHint: Based on the latest Git commit that changed the snapshot file.

busy.pushPrepare: Working out what would be pushed…
busy.updateCheck: Asking the remote for the latest commit…

pending.push: This pushes {files} files, {n} of them differing from the cloud. Confirm to write it.
pending.pull: The cloud holds {remote} entries, {n} of them differing from this machine. Confirm to change this machine.
pending.import: This writes {n} items. This machine’s own listen address, theme, and so on are left alone. Confirm to change this machine.
pending.edit: This changes {n} settings. Confirm to write them and reload the plugin.
pending.update: The dependency will be set to {spec}; DSH must be restarted afterwards. Update now?

compat.blocked: Fix the items above first: writing them now would silently do nothing.

edit.title: Portable settings
edit.intro: These are the settings that travel ({name}). Save, and you will see exactly what changed first.
edit.noop: No change from the current settings.

update.title: This plugin
update.unknown: The installed commit is unknown: the profile manifest records no commit for it.
update.noSpec: This profile does not list the plugin as a dependency, so the installed version cannot be told.
update.notGit: This copy is a local link install. Edit the code and restart DSH instead.
update.availableUnknown: Newer version available: {to} (the installed one cannot be identified)

preview.title: Preview
preview.empty: Cannot read this machine yet. If it has several profiles, set one in the config first; you can also use “Export to file” below to see what would be taken.
preview.pickHint: This machine has {names}. Only the selected one is synced; the rest stay as they are.

result.updated: Updated to {to}. Restart DSH for it to take effect.
